what: Platform-pack read entries, as data (PHASE8_PLAN 15.15's endpoint layer; packs are data choosing a driver, the operator's ruling of 2026-10-26, C1753): per config dialect, each read's show command and the pattern one line of its output fills (Python regular expression, named groups).
